records.rationale: The last-resort Reload control on this render-crash fallback intentionally avoids depending on the shared Button primitive, since Button lives in shared design-system code that could plausibly be part of whatever just crashed the render tree -- see this file's own header comment.
records.reviewCondition: ErrorBoundary's documented dependency-free requirement is revisited

records.rationale: Token-independent emergency-screen background: must render correctly even if tokens.generated.css itself failed to load (the exact scenario this fallback exists for). Matches DESIGN_SYSTEM.md's UI-SPEC 'Token-independent ErrorBoundary fallback colors' carve-out.
records.reviewCondition: ErrorBoundary's documented dependency-free requirement is revisited

records.rationale: Token-independent emergency-screen foreground text color, paired with shell-error-boundary-screen-background for guaranteed contrast even with zero stylesheet dependency.
Token-independent 'GOLC hit an unexpected error' heading color -- the revoked/error red must remain visible even if the generated theme tokens never loaded.
Token-independent explanatory-body text color, paired against the same bare .screen background.
Token-independent subtle-panel background behind the raw crash stack trace -- the single most important diagnostic on this screen, so its own contrast pairing cannot depend on any stylesheet loading.

Token-independent crash-stack-trace text color. Written as rgb() rather than the identical #8a887f hex used by .body's own color so the checker's exception-matching mechanism (which can only resolve a match to exactly one diagnostic per rule+path+value) can address this declaration independently of shell-error-boundary-body-color -- both render the exact same muted gray.

Token-independent Reload button label color -- the operator's one recovery action must stay legible with zero stylesheet dependency. Written as rgb() rather than the identical #e23a2e hex used by .title's own color so the checker's exception-matching mechanism can address this declaration independently of shell-error-boundary-title-color -- both render the exact same revoked red.

The Ctrl+K quick-switcher's borderless, icon-adjacent filter input has no visible label by design (Discord-style command palette) -- Field always renders a visible <label>, which does not fit this compact composition, and there is no bare unlabeled-input primitive in the design system.
records.reviewCondition: an unlabeled/borderless input primitive is added to the design system

records.rationale: Each search result is a role="option" row inside a role="listbox" (ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter keyboard selection, aria-selected), not a discrete Button/IconButton action -- it composes a leading icon, a truncating label, and a trailing group tag in one native <button> so a click on any part of the row commits that destination, which Button's fixed label/icon slots don't express.
records.reviewCondition: a shared selectable-list-row-as-button primitive is added to the design system
